name: Pomegranate Juice
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO as it's low FODMAP. Choose 100% pure juice without added high FODMAP sweeteners.
preparationTips: Choose 100% pure pomegranate juice without added sugars or sweeteners
Check labels to avoid juice blends with high FODMAP fruits like apple or pear
Store opened juice in refrigerator and consume within recommended timeframe
Consider diluting with water if too tart or to reduce sugar content
pairsWellWith: Sparkling water for a refreshing spritzer
